items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: little Happy, the tenor man, was the -- he was the tenor man with Vernon Andrade. He was in there.

ctx.x: Well, Barney Bigard was there, and let's see, Johnny Hodges I never saw there, but -- well, see, Rex was there, but he wasn't with Duke then. Rex I think was with Fletcher Henderson at the time. And there was a

trombone player there, his name escapes me, that played with Fletcher too. He used to be there. And I think Bill Coleman would drop in now and then. Oh, it actually depended who was in town. Any of the bands that came in town, they were -- oh, Louis Metcalf. Louis Metcalf used to come in there. He was at that time playing up with Vernon Andrade, at the Savoy Ballroom, and little Happy, the tenor man, was the -- he was the tenor man with Vernon Andrade. He was in there. I guess at one time or another most…
Were there many white musicians who jammed in Harlem?
